title: Senior Product Manager, Growth & Monetization
description:
PulseMetrics is a Series C B2B SaaS analytics platform. We're building out our growth and monetization team and need a Senior PM who can own pricing, packaging, and growth experimentation.

This is a high-impact role that requires deep growth expertise. You'll be the first PM dedicated to our monetization surface.

What the role requires:
- 6+ years of PM experience
- You must have led growth experimentation at scale — A/B testing, multivariate tests, funnel optimization — this is not negotiable
- Deep experience with sales-led GTM motions including how products support enterprise sales cycles
- Pricing and packaging ownership — you've defined pricing tiers and led pricing strategy projects
- Comfortable with quantitative analysis and statistical significance in experiment design
- Remote OK, US-based

What you'll own:
- Pricing and packaging strategy in close collaboration with Finance and Sales
- Growth experimentation roadmap — activation, upgrade, expansion revenue
- Sales-assist tooling and deal desk workflow integrations
- PLG motion design for our self-serve tier

We need someone who can drive revenue, not just product. The right candidate has owned a revenue or ARR metric before and has run growth experiments that actually moved the needle.

Comp: $180k-$220k + equity
